releases.name: v0.3.0 - Initial public release
releases.body:
First public release of opencode-autoguard: automatic permission review for OpenCode.

Features:
- Three-tier permission review (Tier C local deny rules, Tier A fast-pass, Tier B LLM judge)
- OpenAI-compatible LLM judge with session context digest
- Rejection circuit breaker and GOLDEN human-override feedback
- webfetch prompt-injection review at tool.execute.after (defense in depth)
- Structured audit logs (audit-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl, override:true gold labels)
- 562-case labeled dataset and eval harness (local rules: 0 miss, 0 false positive)

Install:
npm install opencode-autoguard

Full changelog: CHANGELOG.md
